algorithm.description: Quorum algorithm used: 'ffsplit' (fixed failover) or 'lms' (linear model scoring).

certdir.description: Directory containing TLS certificates (CA, server cert, server key). Must be readable by the qnetd user.

clients.description: List of trusted client configurations (by certificate CN or IP). If empty, all verified clients are allowed.

algorithm.description: Optional algorithm override for this client. Use empty to inherit global setting.

cn.description: Client certificate Common Name (CN) or IP address.

node_id.description: Optional custom node ID (1–15 alphanumeric characters). Must be unique across cluster nodes.

crl_file.description: Path to Certificate Revocation List (CRL) file. Leave empty if CRL is not used.

host.description: IP address the qnetd daemon binds to. Use '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces or a specific IP.

interval.description: Heartbeat interval in milliseconds between qnetd and its clients.

log_file.description: Path to qnetd log file. Leave empty to log to stdout/syslog instead.

log_level.description: Minimum logging level. Messages at or above this level are logged.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

max_missed.description: Number of consecutive heartbeat misses before a client is marked as failed.

minimum_nodes.description: Minimum number of nodes required in the cluster to maintain quorum (including qdevice).

port.description: TCP port used for incoming qnetd connections. Must match the client’s expected port.

timeout.description: Time in milliseconds before qnetd considers a client request timed out.

tls_algorithm.description: TLS cipher strength preference. Use 'high', 'medium', 'low', or a specific OpenSSL cipher string.

work_threads.description: Number of worker threads. Set to 0 to auto-detect (recommended).
